dedupe_keys.name: bgs geotechnical site investigation records scotland and northern england

description: This is the British Geological Survey's collection of more than 19,000 geotechnical site investigation reports for Scotland and Northern England, with records of boreholes and trial pits, geotechnical test results and interpretative reports from many sources. The collection began around 1960 to hold the growing number of shallow post-war drillings for building and road construction, kept apart from the Borehole Journal collection of deeper mineral bores. Reports are indexed on the Land Survey Record Index, and the boreholes and trial pits with adequate site plans are indexed on the Single Onshore Borehole Index; reports for Northern England were held in the Shallow Borehole File, which is no longer added to. Coverage: Scotland and Northern England. Access: reports are available for consultation on microfilm and only their factual parts are open to public inspection; the data.gov.uk entry links to the BGS homepage. Licence: BGS terms; consultation is free according to the entry, which does not state charges. Caveats: not a downloadable dataset, and interpretative parts are withheld. Simulation uses: ground conditions for foundation design, subsidence and landslide susceptibility of buildings. Related records: KoreaGeoTechDB boring logs.
